volunteerExperiences.description:
- Streamlined signup and matching process for essential workers nationwide and donors with extra household supplies during the COVID-19 pandemic via an Express API integrated with Cloud Firestore; eliminating manual bottlenecks and helping the program to reach thousands of people, facilitate over $1 million in in-kind donations, and secure over $60K in funding.
- Built portal allowing 100+ volunteers to oversee and facilitate thousands of ongoing essential worker/donor matches.
